course_name_original: Probabilités, statistiques et incertitudes / Probability, statistics and uncertainties

learning_outcomes.text: The knowledge and understanding of a wide range of fundamental sciences and the associated ability for analysis and synthesis.
The ability to mobilize the resources of a specific scientific and technical field.
Mastery of engineering methods and tools: identification, modeling, and solving of even unfamiliar and incompletely defined problems, the use of computer tools, analysis, and system design.

syllabus_topics: Cumulative distribution function and real random variables
Point estimation and confidence interval estimation
bibliography: P. Bremaud, An introduction to probabilistic modelling, Springer, 1988
J.L. Femenias, Probabilités et statistique pour les sciences physiques, Dunod, 2003
D. Foata et A. Fuchs, Calcul des probabilités, Dunod, 1993
R. Veysseyre, Statistique et probabilités pour l’ingénieur, Dunod, 2e édition, 2007
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
